title: Mandarin family words
examples: How do you say 'mother' in Mandarin?
When do I use a measure word?

explain.say: Today we learn some Mandarin words for family members. Say 'mama' in Mandarin. It is māma.
Next we learn the word for father. Say 'baba' in Mandarin. It is bàba.
To talk about siblings, we say 'brother' and 'sister'. Brother is xiōngdì. Sister is jiějie.
Mandarin uses special words for counting things. These are called measure words. For example, a book needs a measure word.
Let us count three apples. We say sān ge píngguǒ. 'Ge' is a common measure word.
In real life, you count your pencils. If you have five pencils, you say wǔ ge bǐ. This uses a measure word.

faq.q: How do I say 'mother' in Mandarin?
faq.a: You say māma. You can also ask by pointing to a picture of a mother.
asks: What is the word for mom?
Can you teach me the word for mama?

faq.q: What is the difference between a brother and a sister?
faq.a: Brother is xiōngdì and sister is jiějie. They are different words for different people.
asks: How do I say my sister?
What word do I use for siblings?

faq.q: When do I need to use a measure word?
faq.a: You use a measure word when you count something. It tells us how many of that thing there are.
asks: Do I always use a measure word?
What is the rule for counting things?

faq.a: The measure word changes depending on what you are counting. 'Ge' is common for many things.
asks: Is there one measure word for everything?

faq.q: Can I just point and say 'mama'?
faq.a: It is better to say the word aloud. Speaking helps you remember the sound correctly.
asks: Should I just remember the sound?

facts: Māma means mother in Mandarin Chinese.
Bàba means father in Mandarin Chinese.
Measure words are used when counting nouns in Mandarin.

quiz.say: If you have two books, how do you count them?
quiz.why: Běn is the correct measure word used specifically for books.

wrong.1: Ge is a general measure word, but books have their own specific word.
wrong.2: This is a common spelling mistake, but the correct character is běn.
wrong.3: Shū is the word for book, not the word used to count it.

quiz.say: What is the Mandarin word for father?
quiz.why: Bàba is the established word for father in Mandarin.

wrong.0: This is an incomplete word and does not mean father.
wrong.2: Māma is the word used for mother.

quiz.say: How do you count four chairs?
quiz.why: Ge is a very common and acceptable general measure word for objects like chairs.

wrong.1: Běn is used for flat objects like books, not chairs.
wrong.2: Zhāng is typically used for flat items like cloth or paper.
wrong.3: Yī is the number one, not the measure word.
